items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in Wednesday’s practice, the first time since his ankle injury. Rapoport confirmed full participation.
items.why: First full practice since high ankle sprain; Rapoport earlier expected return vs Bills.
items.implication: Strong path to ACTIVE Week 8 vs BUF; unlocks Ravens offense and Zay Flowers.
items.opportunity: High snap share, rushing upside, and unlock for Flowers YPRR leader.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday’s practice. Unexpected after prior clean bill; St. Brown also DNP ankle.
items.why: Shoulder issue; late-game slide noted but previously downplayed. Campbell holding some off feet.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday closely for Week 8 vs MIN; risk of limited or OUT.
items.opportunity: If plays, remains RB1 usage; if OUT, committee or backups elevated.
items.conflict: Prior Levitan view Gibbs almost certainly fine post-slide.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday. Coach Dan Campbell said he would likely miss Wed after Sunday injury and expects Thursday return to practice.
items.why: Sore ankle from Week 7; planned rest/walk-through then sit practice.
items.implication: Expected upgrade Thursday; still WR1 if ACTIVE vs MIN.
items.opportunity: High target share remains if plays; Jameson Williams beneficiary if limited/OUT.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest. Rest primary designation suggests low concern.
items.why: Ankle + rest; seen in locker room post-practice. High snap % prior week.
items.implication: Likely resumes practice soon; elite WR1 vs TEN if ACTIVE.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; Tee Higgins secondary if limited.

items.text: Truly special stuff from Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Loses Klint Kubiak, few dynamic threats, DCs shading, stadium knows ball going to him—still ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Outperforming expected points despite scheme/personnel/DC adjustments and concentration.
items.implication: Continue elite WR1/WR2 ranking; high floor/ceiling independent of OC change.
items.opportunity: Route share and target dominance persist; volume + efficiency.

items.text: Ravens 6th in yards per play despite Huntley 50.1% snaps. Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley. Very excited how hard Declan Doyle cooks with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR under backup; full Lamar unlocks scheme and efficiency further.
items.implication: Major WR upside spike if Lamar ACTIVE; stack potential.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley said his hamstring came out great and doesn't believe his back issue will keep him out. Was active prior game after missing two.
items.why: Self-report post-game; gutsy efficient effort despite hobble.
items.implication: Likely full or near-full Week 8; monitor practice.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta. Could be in for a big day against Vikings defense sure to put pressure on Jared Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure-heavy Vikes defense funnels to TE; Lions offense strong.
items.implication: Start with confidence; TE upside week.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/targets if Gibbs/St. Brown limited; Goff checkdowns.
items.conflict: Gibbs/St. Brown DNP could alter or boost targets.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Return from absence; role question post-injury.
items.implication: Monitor snaps/usage in SEA backfield; potential flex if volume there.
items.opportunity: Carries if committee opens; handcuff/backup upside.

items.text: Evan Silva and Adam Levitan: 'I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman' in DEN backfield discussion.
items.why: Backfield shift; Coleman usage rising vs Dobbins/Harvey.
items.implication: Waiver/priority add for DEN RB opportunity.

items.text: Ollie Gordon has scored 14+ PPR points in his last 4 games. He is entering MUST-START territory.
Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule.
items.why: Concentrated production and efficiency driving top ranks across positions.
items.implication: Hold/start core; ROS strong if healthy. Note current DNPs.
items.conflict: Wednesday DNPs for Gibbs/St. Brown create short-term risk.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis at RB. Arguably worst runner in NFL this season yet fantasy RB13 full-PPR PPG via 9 carries inside-5 and 45 targets (leads all RBs).
items.why: Goal-line + receiving volume overrides poor efficiency metrics.
items.implication: RB2/flex value holds via opportunity; not pure runner.
items.conflict: Worst runner metrics vs fantasy output.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Jaylin Noel 15 (left early turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (first since 2024).
items.why: Clear route lead even with Dell return and Noel injury.
items.implication: Alpha WR1 role intact; high target expectation.
